decision_conditions:
All new external facing and roofing materials in respect of all the works hereby approved (and any other incidental works carried out in this connection) shall match those of the existing building in respect of materials used, detailed execution and finished appearance including type, size, colour, bond, pointing, coursing, jointing, profile and texture. 

REASON:  To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area, listed building and conservation area.

<p>The following works, hereby approved, must be completed not later than the expiration of six months beginning with the date of this consent:-</p><ul><li>rendering of the front facade;</li><li>replacement of the front window; and&nbsp;</li><li>installation of the pipe and soil work on the side elevation.</li></ul><p>REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 18(a) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 (as amended), and ensure compliance with the active enforcement notice.&nbsp;</p>
description:
The following renovations are proposed for 13b, a damp, poorly insulated building in need of critical attention, recently purchased by the owners of the adjoining 13a.


Roof Renovation:

1.   Substantial repairs to remedy years of water infiltration affecting supporting timbers and party walls, due to damaged roof tiles, failing coping and flashing.

Exterior (East Elevation facing Sylvester Path):

1.   Repairs and restoration of the lime-rendered facade with approved like-for-like materials due to water infiltration.
2.   Restoration of historical detailing, including the stone coping on the front parapet.
3.   Like-for-like replacement of the existing timber porch canopy due to rot.
4.   Like-for-like replacement of the timber door surround due to rot.
5.   Like-for-like replacement of an existing sash window with a double-glazed solid timber reproduction due to rot and heat loss.
6.   Replacement of the existing timber and glass door with a solid hardwood reproduction.

Exterior (South and West Elevations):

1.   Like-for-like replacement of the existing French door with triple-glazed units to address heat loss.
2.   Like-for-like replacement of 2 existing sash windows with double-glazed solid timber reproductions to address heat loss.
3.   Replacement of the timber and glass door with triple-glazed bifold glass doors to address heat loss.
4.   Replacement of timber-framed skylights with Velux double-glazed units (north-facing roof) to address heat loss.
5.   Installation of Velux double-glazed skylights (south-facing roof).
6.   Repairs and restoration of cracked render on the south and west-facing walls.

Interior:

1.   Installation of an insulated sub-floor over the existing concrete screed floor.
2.   Installation of insulated sub-walls and ceilings.
3.   Replacement of the existing wood-burning stove and flue pipe.
4.   Reconfiguration of partition walls for an open-plan layout, including bathroom, kitchen/living room, and bedroom.
5.   Replacement of the existing electrical system.
6.   Replacement of the existing gas heating system.
